label: Audiogram / podcast clip

kinds.clip: A piece of a podcast or interview: cover art, the speaker's name, a waveform that follows the real sound, and captions.
kinds.card: A branded text card between clips, e.g. the episode title.
kinds.cta: Closing card: where to listen, with a button.

fields.asset: The sound (.wav, .mp3) or a video whose sound to use, from the project assets.
fields.clip.text: What is said in this clip, shown as captions. Copy it word for word from a transcript.
fields.clip.title: A short line above the name, e.g. the show or episode.
fields.image: Cover art for the clip (square works best). Without one the brand logo is shown.
fields.in: Where the clip starts in the file, in seconds.
fields.out: Where it ends, in seconds. At most 120 seconds per clip.
fields.vo: Optional voice line over this card.

description: A podcast or interview clip for social: cover art, the speaker's name and role, a waveform that moves with the real sound, a progress bar and captions, joined by text cards and a closing call to action. Clips take .wav or .mp3 uploads, or the sound of a video.

clip.text: What is said in this clip, word for word.
